"""Bounded download of the author-linked public mirror; no existing data is overwritten."""
import hashlib,json,shutil,stat,time,zipfile
from pathlib import Path,PurePosixPath
from urllib.parse import urlparse
import requests

root=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
out=root/'runs/benchmarks/week5_domain_adaptation/recovery_20261114_5df62d8a'
folder=root/'downloads';folder.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
archive=folder/'dfire_author_linked_kaggle_v1.zip'
part=archive.with_suffix('.zip.part')
destination=root/'datasets/dfire_author_linked_kaggle_v1'
url='https://www.kaggle.com/api/v1/datasets/download/sayedgamal99/smoke-fire-detection-yolo?datasetVersionNumber=1'
receipt={'author_repository':'https://github.com/gaia-solutions-on-demand/DFireDataset',
    'source_url':url,'mirror_version':1,'author_repository_commit':'3890a756b224855f4f7ef8d237a70bc1834a4714',
    'downloaded':False,'extracted':False,'archive_sha256':None,'existing_files_overwritten':False}
started=time.monotonic()
try:
    if archive.exists() or part.exists() or destination.exists():raise FileExistsError('Choose a new archive/version path')
    if shutil.disk_usage(root).free<25_000_000_000:raise ValueError('Disk reserve insufficient')
    with requests.get(url,stream=True,timeout=(20,60),headers={'User-Agent':'DACN-NCKH-research-data-recovery'}) as response:
        receipt['http_status']=response.status_code;receipt['response_host']=urlparse(response.url).hostname
        response.raise_for_status()
        receipt['content_type']=response.headers.get('Content-Type')
        if 'html' in receipt['content_type'].lower():raise ValueError('Download returned HTML, not archive')
        count=0;digest=hashlib.sha256();last=time.monotonic()
        with part.open('xb') as stream:
            for block in response.iter_content(1024*1024):
                count+=len(block)
                if count>5_000_000_000 or time.monotonic()-started>1200:raise ValueError('Download size/time budget exceeded')
                if shutil.disk_usage(root).free<15_000_000_000:raise ValueError('Disk reserve reached')
                stream.write(block);digest.update(block)
                if time.monotonic()-last>20:
                    print('DOWNLOADED_BYTES',count,flush=True);last=time.monotonic()
    receipt.update(downloaded=True,download_bytes=count,archive_sha256=digest.hexdigest())
    if not zipfile.is_zipfile(part):raise ValueError('Invalid ZIP body')
    with zipfile.ZipFile(part) as source:
        entries=source.infolist();total=sum(p.file_size for p in entries)
        if total>8_000_000_000 or len(entries)>60000:raise ValueError('Archive expansion budget exceeded')
        for entry in entries:
            name=PurePosixPath(entry.filename)
            if name.is_absolute() or '..' in name.parts or '\\' in entry.filename or ':' in entry.filename or stat.S_ISLNK(entry.external_attr>>16):
                raise ValueError('Unsafe archive entry')
        destination.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
        for index,entry in enumerate(entries,1):
            target=destination.joinpath(*PurePosixPath(entry.filename).parts)
            if entry.is_dir():target.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);continue
            target.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
            with source.open(entry) as src,target.open('xb') as dst:shutil.copyfileobj(src,dst,1024*1024)
            if index%5000==0:print('EXTRACTED_ENTRIES',index,'/',len(entries),flush=True)
    # Rename only this newly created file to its final sibling; originals are never moved.
    part.rename(archive)
    receipt.update(extracted=True,archive=str(archive.relative_to(root)),corpus_root=str(destination.relative_to(root)),
                   uncompressed_bytes=total,archive_entries=len(entries),status='RECOVERED_REQUIRES_CONTENT_SPLIT_SEMANTIC_AUDIT')
except Exception as error:
    receipt.update(status='BLOCKED_DOWNLOAD_OR_EXTRACTION',error_type=type(error).__name__,error=str(error)[:400])
finally:
    receipt['duration_seconds']=time.monotonic()-started
    (out/'archive_recovery.json').write_text(json.dumps(receipt,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
    print(json.dumps(receipt),flush=True)

"""Hash and audit recovered mirror; no source labels/splits are altered."""
import csv,json,sys,time
from collections import Counter,defaultdict
from pathlib import Path
import cv2,numpy as np,yaml

root=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2];sys.path.insert(0,str(root))
from ground_truth_studio.integrity_service import sha256
from src.domain_adaptation import read_yolo_boxes
from src.preannotation import fingerprint
out=root/'runs/benchmarks/week5_domain_adaptation/recovery_20261114_5df62d8a'
corpus=root/'datasets/dfire_author_linked_kaggle_v1'
recovery=json.loads((out/'archive_recovery.json').read_text());assert recovery['extracted']
assert sha256(root/recovery['archive'])==recovery['archive_sha256']
started=time.monotonic();cv2.setNumThreads(2)
files=sorted(p for p in corpus.rglob('*') if p.is_file())
images=[p for p in files if p.suffix.lower() in {'.jpg','.jpeg','.png','.bmp'}]
labels=[p for p in files if p.suffix.lower()=='.txt' and p.parent.name=='labels']
raw=root.parent/'datasets/DFire_official_raw'
author_train={s.strip() for s in (raw/'dfire_train.txt').read_text().splitlines()}
author_test={s.strip() for s in (raw/'dfire_test.txt').read_text().splitlines()}
legacy=root/'runs/benchmarks/week5_domain_adaptation/dataset_candidate_20261114_73034262/image_label_inventory.csv'
old=list(csv.DictReader(legacy.open(encoding='utf-8')));legacy_sha={r['image_sha256'] for r in old}
cached=json.loads((root/'runs/benchmarks/vn_pos_preannotation/run_20261114_6942fa56/fingerprints/image_fingerprints.json').read_text())
legacy_perceptual=defaultdict(list)
for row in cached:
 if row['corpus']=='dataset' and row['image_sha256'] in legacy_sha and row['variants'][0]['std']>=10:
    key=(row['variants'][0]['phash'],row['variants'][0]['dhash'])
    legacy_perceptual[key].append(row['relative_path'])
snapshots=[];rows=[];by_sha=defaultdict(list);by_perceptual=defaultdict(list)
classes=Counter();counts=Counter();errors=[];missing=[];cross_author=[];legacy_exact=[];legacy_near=[];samples={};used_labels=set()
for index,image in enumerate(images,1):
 relative=image.relative_to(corpus).as_posix();split=next((s for s in image.parts if s in {'train','val','valid','test'}),'UNKNOWN')
 label=image.parent.parent/'labels'/(image.stem+'.txt');digest=sha256(image)
 pixels=cv2.imread(str(image));boxes=[];error='';label_sha=None
 if pixels is None:error='CORRUPT_IMAGE'
 if not label.exists():missing.append(relative);error+=';MISSING_LABEL'
 else:
    used_labels.add(label);label_sha=sha256(label)
    try:boxes=read_yolo_boxes(label)
    except ValueError as exc:error+=';'+str(exc)
 if error:errors.append({'image':relative,'label':str(label.relative_to(corpus)) if label.exists() else None,'error':error})
 classes.update(int(b[0]) for b in boxes);counts[split]+=1
 author='train' if image.name in author_train else 'test' if image.name in author_test else 'UNKNOWN'
 if (split in {'train','val','valid'} and author=='test') or (split=='test' and author!='test'):cross_author.append(relative)
 row={'image_path':image.relative_to(root).as_posix(),'image_sha256':digest,'label_path':label.relative_to(root).as_posix() if label.exists() else '',
      'label_sha256':label_sha,'mirror_split':split,'author_reservation':author,'valid':not error,
      'bbox_count':len(boxes),'scene_provenance':'UNKNOWN; grouping review required','approved_for_training':False}
 rows.append(row);by_sha[digest].append(row)
 if digest in legacy_sha:legacy_exact.append(relative)
 if pixels is not None:
    fp=fingerprint(pixels);v=fp['variants'][0]
    if v['std']>=10:
      key=(v['phash'],v['dhash']);by_perceptual[key].append(row)
      for old_path in legacy_perceptual.get(key,[]):legacy_near.append({'dfire':relative,'legacy':old_path,'status':'PERCEPTUAL_HASH_CANDIDATE_NOT_CONTENT_PROOF'})
    signature=tuple(sorted({int(b[0]) for b in boxes}))
    if len(samples.get(signature,[]))<3 and not error:
      small=cv2.resize(pixels,(320,220))
      for c,x,y,w,h in boxes:
        color=(255,200,50) if c==0 else (50,70,255)
        cv2.rectangle(small,(int((x-w/2)*320),int((y-h/2)*220)),(int((x+w/2)*320),int((y+h/2)*220)),color,2)
        cv2.putText(small,'SMOKE 0' if c==0 else 'FIRE 1',(max(0,int((x-w/2)*320)),max(15,int((y-h/2)*220))),cv2.FONT_HERSHEY_SIMPLEX,.4,color,1)
      samples.setdefault(signature,[]).append((small,relative))
 if index%2000==0:print('DFIRE_CONTENT',index,'/',len(images),'INVALID',len(errors),flush=True)
for path in files:snapshots.append({'path':path.relative_to(corpus).as_posix(),'sha256':sha256(path),'bytes':path.stat().st_size})
for row in rows:
 assert sha256(root/row['image_path'])==row['image_sha256']
 if row['label_path']:assert sha256(root/row['label_path'])==row['label_sha256']
def writecsv(name,data):
 if data:
  with (out/name).open('w',encoding='utf-8',newline='') as f:
   w=csv.DictWriter(f,fieldnames=list(data[0]));w.writeheader();w.writerows(data)
writecsv('dfire_file_sha256.csv',snapshots);writecsv('dfire_image_manifest.csv',rows);writecsv('legacy_dfire_perceptual_candidates.csv',legacy_near)
exact=[{'sha256':key,'images':[r['image_path'] for r in group],'splits':sorted({r['mirror_split'] for r in group})} for key,group in by_sha.items() if len({r['mirror_split'] for r in group})>1]
near=[{'images':[r['image_path'] for r in group],'splits':sorted({r['mirror_split'] for r in group})} for group in by_perceptual.values() if len({r['mirror_split'] for r in group})>1]
panels=[pair for group in samples.values() for pair in group]
canvas=np.full((len(panels)*250,640,3),240,np.uint8)
for index,(pixels,name) in enumerate(panels):
 canvas[index*250:index*250+220,:320]=pixels
 cv2.putText(canvas,name[:95],(4,index*250+240),cv2.FONT_HERSHEY_SIMPLEX,.35,(0,0,0),1)
cv2.imwrite(str(out/'source_bbox_visual_check.jpg'),canvas)
cfg=yaml.safe_load((corpus/'data.yaml').read_text())
result={'status':'PARTIAL','source_provenance':'AUTHOR_LINKED_KAGGLE_MIRROR_VERSION_1',
 'archive_sha256':recovery['archive_sha256'],'files_hashed':len(snapshots),'images':len(images),'labels':len(labels),
 'images_by_mirror_split':dict(counts),'numeric_class_boxes':dict(classes),'source_class_mapping':cfg.get('names'),
 'missing_labels':missing,'invalid_samples':errors,'orphan_labels':len(set(labels)-used_labels),
 'mirror_violates_author_test_reservation':cross_author,'author_names_not_present':sorted((author_train|author_test)-{p.name for p in images}),
 'cross_split_exact_duplicate_groups':exact,'cross_split_perceptual_candidate_groups':near,
 'legacy_exact_image_matches':len(legacy_exact),'legacy_perceptual_candidate_pairs':len(legacy_near),
 'near_duplicate_screen':'Equal full-view pHash+dHash, texture std>=10; limited screen, not complete scene independence proof',
 'source_scene_ids_available':False,'pixels_label_hashes_preserved':True,'labels_remapped':False,
 'bbox_visual_sample_paths':[name for _,name in panels],'semantic_check':'SOURCE_METADATA_AVAILABLE; VISUAL_REVIEW_PENDING',
 'split_ready':False,'yaml_created':False,'baseline_map':None,'duration_seconds':time.monotonic()-started}
(out/'dfire_content_audit.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
print('DFIRE_CONTENT_AUDITED',json.dumps({k:result[k] for k in ['images','labels','images_by_mirror_split','legacy_exact_image_matches','legacy_perceptual_candidate_pairs','duration_seconds']}),flush=True)

"""Create conservative candidate/quarantine manifests; never declare unknown groups ready."""
import csv,json,shutil,sys
from collections import Counter
from pathlib import Path

root=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2];sys.path.insert(0,str(root))
from ground_truth_studio.integrity_service import sha256
out=root/'runs/benchmarks/week5_domain_adaptation/recovery_20261114_5df62d8a'
a=json.loads((out/'dfire_content_audit.json').read_text());r=json.loads((out/'archive_recovery.json').read_text())
rows=list(csv.DictReader((out/'dfire_image_manifest.csv').open(encoding='utf-8')))
near={p for group in a['cross_split_perceptual_candidate_groups'] for p in group['images']}
exact={p for group in a['cross_split_exact_duplicate_groups'] for p in group['images']}
legacy_pairs=list(csv.DictReader((out/'legacy_dfire_perceptual_candidates.csv').open()))
legacy_shared={'datasets/dfire_author_linked_kaggle_v1/'+r['dfire'] for r in legacy_pairs}
vn_rows=list(csv.DictReader((root/'runs/benchmarks/week5_domain_adaptation/run_20261114_73034262_v2/vn_image_candidates.csv').open(encoding='utf-8')))
vn_hashes={r['image_sha256'] for r in vn_rows}
observed={'datasets/dfire_author_linked_kaggle_v1/data/val/images/AoF00008.jpg',
          'datasets/dfire_author_linked_kaggle_v1/data/test/images/AoF06723.jpg'}
clean={s:[] for s in ['train','val','test']};quarantine=[]
for row in rows:
 reasons=[]
 if row['valid']!='True':reasons.append('INVALID_IMAGE_OR_BBOX')
 if row['image_path'] in near:reasons.append('CROSS_SPLIT_PERCEPTUAL_CANDIDATE')
 if row['image_path'] in exact:reasons.append('CROSS_SPLIT_EXACT_DUPLICATE')
 if row['image_path'] in observed:reasons.append('OBSERVED_CAMERA0001_VAL_TEST_OVERLAP')
 if row['image_path'] in legacy_shared:reasons.append('VISUALLY_SHARED_LEGACY_PHOTO_DIFFERENT_ENCODING')
 item={**row,'source_asset_sha256':row['image_sha256'],'eligible_for_evaluation':False,
       'quarantine_reasons':';'.join(reasons),'scene_group_verified':False}
 if reasons:quarantine.append(item)
 else:clean[row['mirror_split']].append(item)
for name,values in [('dfire_candidate_'+s,v) for s,v in clean.items()]+[('dfire_quarantined',quarantine)]:
 if values:
  with (out/(name+'.csv')).open('w',encoding='utf-8',newline='') as f:
   w=csv.DictWriter(f,fieldnames=list(values[0]));w.writeheader();w.writerows(values)
assert all(row['author_reservation']=='train' for row in clean['train']+clean['val'])
assert all(row['author_reservation']=='test' for row in clean['test'])
summary={'status':'PARTIAL','author_test_not_moved_to_training':True,
 'unresolved_cross_split_relations_removed_from_candidate_evaluation':True,
 'candidate_counts':{s:len(v) for s,v in clean.items()},'quarantined_samples':len(quarantine),
 'actual_training_or_eval_rows':0,'split_ready':False,
 'dfire_vn_exact_image_sha_overlap':sum(row['image_sha256'] in vn_hashes for row in rows),
 'dfire_vn_full_near_duplicate_screen_complete':False,
 'legacy_visual_comparison':'Three paired images visually share the same photograph content with resizing/reencoding; not proof of provenance for the whole legacy corpus',
 'remaining_blockers':['UNKNOWN_CAMERA_SCENE_GROUPS','OBSERVED_CAMERA0001_VAL_TEST_OVERLAP',
                       'BASELINE_TRAIN_MEMBERSHIP_NOT_AUTHENTICATED','VN_BBOX_APPROVALS_AND_LINEAGE_MISSING'],
 'semantic_mapping_inspection':{'source_yaml_names':a['source_class_mapping'],'target':{'0':'smoke','1':'fire'},
   'visual_examples':['AoF06978.jpg','AoF07718.jpg','AoF07738.jpg'],
   'finding':'Consistent smoke=0/fire=1 on metadata and three visual samples; technical AI inspection, no human bbox approval',
   'labels_remapped':False},
 'sample_camera_finding':{'val':'AoF00008.jpg','test':'AoF06723.jpg',
   'finding':'Camera0001 overlay and same hill/parking view visible in both images; not a whole-corpus camera catalog'}}
(out/'dfire_curation.json').write_text(json.dumps(summary,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
g=json.loads((out/'readiness_gates.json').read_text())
if not (out/'readiness_initial_raw_path.json').exists():
 (out/'readiness_initial_raw_path.json').write_text(json.dumps(g,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
g.update(DFIRE_STATUS='PARTIAL_RECOVERED_CONTENT_AND_GROUP_QA_REQUIRED',archive=r['archive'],
 archive_sha256=r['archive_sha256'],author_repository_commit=r['author_repository_commit'],mirror_version=1,
 recovered_corpus_root=r['corpus_root'],recovered_images=a['images'],recovered_labels=a['labels'],
 semantic_mapping_verified_on_source_and_visual_samples=True,
